SCOWL is derived from many sources, most of which are in the Public Domain.
Data from the Corpus of Contemporary American English (COCA) was also used.

The generated Quizbase list uses SCOWL size 40, British spelling B, and variant
level 1. It excludes SCOWL's supplemental "extra" tag, nonword/special/wordpart
categories, marked offensive/vulgar entries, and a small Quizbase-reviewed set
of unsuitable or unclear short forms. It is below size 80 and does not use
Australian spelling data.
